title: The Credit at the End of the Film
title_ja: 映画の最後に載せる名前
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。リンクは制作台帳であり実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: A group of students created a short film for an exhibition about the history of their local shopping street.
sentences.ja: 生徒のグループは地元商店街の歴史についての展示のため短い映画を制作した。

sentences.en: They interviewed shop owners, collected photographs, and spent several weekends recording scenes in different parts of the neighborhood.
sentences.ja: 店主にインタビューし、写真を集め、何度かの週末に地域のさまざまな場所で撮影した。

sentences.en: At the end of their project, the students prepared a list of names to appear in the final credits.
sentences.ja: 活動の終わりに、最後のクレジットに表示する名前の一覧を用意した。

sentences.en: The list originally included only the students who had operated the camera or appeared on the screen.
sentences.ja: 当初の一覧には撮影を担当した生徒と画面に登場した生徒だけが含まれていた。

sentences.en: One group member noticed that several people who had made important contributions were missing from the list.
sentences.ja: ある班員は重要な貢献をした数人の名前が一覧にないことに気づいた。

sentences.en: Another student had arranged interviews, checked the accuracy of subtitles, and kept track of permission forms.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒はインタビューの手配、字幕の正確さの確認、許可書の管理を行っていた。

sentences.en: A shop owner had also introduced the group to several residents who were willing to share their memories.
sentences.ja: ある店主は思い出を話す意思のある住民を数人紹介してくれた。

sentences.en: Although these people did not appear in the completed film, their assistance had made much of the work possible.
sentences.ja: これらの人は完成した映画には出なかったが、その支援によって作業の多くが可能になった。

sentences.en: The group discussed how to recognize each contribution without giving viewers an inaccurate impression of the work involved.
sentences.ja: グループは関わった作業について誤った印象を与えずに各貢献をどう認めるか議論した。

sentences.en: They decided to identify different responsibilities instead of placing every participant under the same general description.
sentences.ja: 全員を同じ一般的な説明の下に置く代わりに、異なる担当を明示することにした。

sentences.en: For people outside the school, they also asked whether those individuals wanted their names to be publicly displayed.
sentences.ja: 学校外の人には名前の公表を希望するかどうかも尋ねた。

sentences.en: One resident preferred not to be named, so the group respected that decision and described the contribution anonymously.
sentences.ja: ある住民は匿名を希望したため、決定を尊重して名前を出さず貢献を説明した。

sentences.en: Before presenting the film, the students shared the revised credits with everyone who had participated in the project.
sentences.ja: 映画を発表する前に修正したクレジットを参加者全員と共有した。

sentences.en: This gave people an opportunity to correct mistakes or suggest a more accurate description of their roles.
sentences.ja: これによって誤りを訂正したり担当についてより正確な説明を提案したりする機会が生まれた。

sentences.en: The final version was longer than the original list, but the group considered the additional time worthwhile.
sentences.ja: 最終版は当初の一覧より長くなったが、追加の時間には価値があると考えた。

sentences.en: The revised credits communicated how many different kinds of effort had supported the production of the film.
sentences.ja: 修正したクレジットは映画制作に多くの異なる努力が関わったことを伝えた。

sentences.en: Through this experience, the students learned that acknowledging other people's work requires attention as well as good intentions.
sentences.ja: この経験から他者の仕事を認めるには善意だけでなく注意深さも必要だと学んだ。

sentences.en: Visible participation was not the only form of contribution, and public recognition was not desirable for everyone.
sentences.ja: 目に見える参加だけが貢献の形ではなく、公に認められることを誰もが望むわけでもなかった。

sentences.en: A fair description of a shared project needed to respect both the actual work performed and the wishes of contributors.
sentences.ja: 共同活動を公平に説明するには実際の仕事と協力者の希望の両方を尊重する必要があった。

sentences.en: For the students, the final credits became a record of cooperation rather than simply a list of familiar faces.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちにとってクレジットは単に見慣れた顔の一覧ではなく協力の記録になった。

options: A fictional journey to the Moon.
The history of a local shopping street.

questions.prompt: Who was originally listed in the credits?
options: Every person living in the neighborhood.
Students who used the camera or appeared on screen.

questions.prompt: What other work had one student done?
questions.explanation_ja: 取材の手配と字幕確認。

questions.prompt: Why were the original credits incomplete?
options: They listed too many people who had acted in the film.
They omitted people whose important work was not visible on screen.
They contained no description of the exhibition.
They had been written in a foreign language.
questions.explanation_ja: 画面に出ない重要な仕事を見落とした。

questions.prompt: How did the group describe contributions?
options: By using one identical role for everyone.
By listing people according to height.

questions.prompt: Why was one resident's name not displayed?
options: The group had lost the interview recording.
The resident had not helped the project.
The resident wanted someone else's name listed.
The resident preferred not to be named.
questions.explanation_ja: 本人の匿名希望を尊重。

questions.prompt: What did participants have a chance to do?
options: Change the subject of the entire film.
Remove every other person from the credits.
Correct mistakes and clarify descriptions of their work.
questions.explanation_ja: 誤りを訂正し仕事の説明を具体化。
手間をかける価値がある。

questions.prompt: Why is public recognition not always the best response?
options: Public recognition can never be helpful.
Some contributors may prefer not to have their identity displayed.
All contributors want to receive money instead.
No one wants to be thanked.
questions.explanation_ja: 名前を公にしたくない人もいる。

questions.prompt: What principle does the passage emphasize?
options: Only people who appear in a film deserve credit.
Give fair recognition to actual contributions while respecting people's wishes.
Every contributor must be named publicly.
Credits should always be as short as possible.
questions.explanation_ja: 貢献と本人の希望をともに尊重する。

grammar.explanation_ja: 関係代名詞whoがstudentsを修飾し、過去完了は以前の行動を示す。
